subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Three biotypes emerged: severe-combined with emotional dysregulation (widespread medial prefrontal cortex-pallidum alterations, n = 142), predominantly hyperactive/impulsive (anterior cingulate cortex-pallidum circuit alterations, n = 177), and predominantly inattentive (superior frontal gyrus alterations, n = 127), each characterized by distinct clinical profiles and longitudinal trajectories.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract. The core result: brain-derived clustering yields three biotypes named for, and loosely matching, the DSM presentations.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: This convergence provides compelling evidence that these presentations reflect genuine neurobiological entities, biologically validating these long-observed clinical distinctions.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text. The authors' interpretation that symptom-free clustering converging with DSM presentations validates them biologically; medium because it is the authors' own reading of modest cluster agreement.

subject: paper:chen-2025-adhd-ct-subtypes
quote: We identified three distinct subtypes of ADHD with abnormal cortical thickness (CT) compared to the controls, namely, the under-developed (lower CT), over-developed (higher CT), and mixed subtypes, based on 6509 adolescents from the Adolescent Brian Cognitive Development (ABCD) study.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract (typo 'Brian' is in the source). Independent method also finds a three-way split — convergent on heterogeneity having brain structure, though the subtypes are not the same as Pan's.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Specifically, the validation cohort exhibited consistent hyperactive/impulsive patterns across biotypes, although inattention profiles could not be fully reproduced, likely due to confounding factors including younger participant age, different recruitment strategies, and cross-cultural variations.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text. The replication was partial: the inattentive profile — the one most relevant to an inattentive-leaning case — did not fully reproduce.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Third, our putative biotypes may represent salient points along underlying dimensional continua rather than qualitatively distinct diagnostic entities.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text. The authors themselves frame the biotypes as regions on continua, not kinds.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Third, our putative biotypes may represent salient points along underlying dimensional continua rather than qualitatively distinct diagnostic entities.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text. Indirect support: even the within-ADHD subdivisions are read dimensionally, consistent with the continuum view; low because the study does not test the ADHD/non-ADHD boundary.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Our analysis provides preliminary evidence that these neurotransmitter systems may be differentially involved across biotypes, but they cannot represent actual alterations in receptor systems themselves or inform treatment approaches.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text (citation markers omitted). The authors disclaim treatment implications of the receptor-map correlations.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Second, the overlap in topological deviations between ADHD and TDCs underscores the subtle and complex nature of ADHD-related brain alterations.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text. Cases and controls overlap on the network measures — the same individual-level non-separability ENIGMA showed for volumes.

subject: paper:pan-2026-adhd-biotypes
quote: Intriguingly, when examining deficient emotional self-regulation, biotype 1 showed more persistent symptoms compared to the marked decreases observed in biotypes 2 and 3
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text. Emotional dysregulation persists over 4 years in one brain-defined subgroup while it declines in the others — a distinct, persistent axis concentrated in the severe-combined biotype.

subject: paper:chen-2025-adhd-ct-subtypes
quote: Interestingly, we found significantly lower cognitive scores together with worse socioeconomic status in the under-developed subtype, and the over-developed subtype had the worst response to stimulant medication.
rationale: Verbatim from the MEDLINE abstract. A reported treatment-response difference by imaging subtype — the honest counterweight, and the likely origin of media claims misattributed to Pan 2026. Retrospective and single-cohort, so it pressures rather than refutes.
